msgs.text: Genera 5 imágenes separadas con Nano Banana 2.1, cada una en su formato y con su referencia (las referencias están adjuntas). Usa los textos tal cual, sin reescribirlos ni añadir nada. REGLA A: Reproduce the EXACT product from the reference image: identical shape, proportions, materials, colours, stones and details; do not redesign it. Leave out any hands, price tags, stickers, shop text and the original background. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. IMAGEN 1 «h» (formato 16:9, referencia agueda-herrera-16.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Boutique campaign still life of a neatly folded leopard print fleece dressing gown and a pair of cosy knitted socks on a linen bed from the reference. The product sits in the right third of the frame and the scene continues to the left, softly out of focus and calm, with room for a headline. Warm natural light, soft textures. One single continuous photograph, never a split screen or collage. IMAGEN 2 «p1» (formato 3:4, referencia agueda-herrera-01.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo of a white lace underwired bra without padding (flat lay) from the reference, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#ECE7E0) background with a soft shadow, crisp detail. IMAGEN 3 «p2» (formato 3:4, referencia agueda-herrera-15.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo of a lilac lace bralette (flat lay) from the reference, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#ECE7E0) background with a soft shadow, crisp detail. IMAGEN 4 «p3» (formato 3:4, referencia agueda-herrera-16.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo of a leopard print fleece dressing gown with a zip (flat lay) from the reference, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#ECE7E0) background with a soft shadow, crisp detail. IMAGEN 5 «p4» (formato 3:4, referencia agueda-herrera-28.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo of a black and cream striped knit sweater with black wide trousers, a loungewear set (flat lay) from the reference, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#ECE7E0) background with a soft shadow, crisp detail.
